EmailTemplate.subject: New India tax regulation - What you need to know
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
As your trusted global payment provider, Flywire would like to share the most recent changes affecting your payers from India.
A new tax regulation, effective October 1, 2020, announced by India's government, requires India banking partners, as authorized dealers, to collect Tax Collection at Source (TCS) for remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS). Payments exceeding ₹7 lakh (700,000 INR; approximately 10,000 USD) within India's financial year from April to March stipulates a 5.0% tax charge. TCS applicability will be determined using the payer's PAN (Permanent Account Number).
We have minimized disruption in the payment process by informing payers of the TCS amount, if applicable. Flywire will notify the payer with a single pop-up. If TCS does not apply to the payment, there will be no change to the existing payment experience.
We understand that with a new process required by the Indian government, there may be questions from our clients and payers. With that in mind, our team at Flywire has created some additional resources to support your students paying from India. Please see below:
Client Help Center Tax Collection at Source (TCS): Common Questions <[[https://help.client.flywire.com/hc/en-us/articles/360017235540-Tax-Collection-at-Source-TCS-Common-Questions-?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Payer Help Center How to pay from India <[[https://help.flywire.com/hc/en-us/sections/360002662834-Paying-from-India?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> Tax Collected at Source FAQ’s <[[https://help.flywire.com/hc/en-us/sections/360004696440-Tax-Collected-at-Source-8-Articles-?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
As always, please feel free to redirect any inquiries from your students to our Customer Support Team here <[[https://help.flywire.com/hc/en-us?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>.
